title: Having been guided to a...
fullPassage: Having been guided to a small desk surrounded by dividers, I sat. It was my first day. Everyone in the office seemed busy and no one even looked at me. It felt as if no one knew I was there. After a while, a woman came over and quietly placed a bouquet of flowers on my desk. Before I could say anything, she walked away. A moment later, she returned with a warm cup of tea. "Welcome aboard," she said with a kind smile. "I know first days can feel a little invisible, but trust me, you'll fit right in." She introduced herself as Sarah and began showing me around the office, introducing me to the rest of the team. One by one, my coworkers greeted me warmly, each offering a kind word or a small gesture of welcome. By lunchtime, what had started as an anxious morning had turned into something truly heartwarming. I no longer felt invisible — I felt accepted.
